speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are here because you have found a breast mass. To help me understand your situation, can you tell me how long you have noticed this lump and exactly where it is located on your chest?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes tumor.

Given the rapid growth of the mass over just four weeks in a 48-year-old woman, this clinical presentation is highly suggestive of a Phyllodes tumor rather than a typical fibroadenoma or carcinoma. I recommend we proceed with a mammogram and ultrasound to better characterize the lesion before scheduling a biopsy. REQUEST TEST: Mammogram and Ultrasound.
